[[Freight Administrator]] '''Ela Harns''' was [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] bays at [[Estaria Central Starport]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Charged with overseeing of all services and fees at the concerning the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] bays, Harns used her position to aid the local rebel cell along with the greater [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Along with two others, [[Hev Lissona]] and [[Ablee Bansak]], she was aware of a [[Estaria Cache|secret cache]] of supplies hidden within the starport, available for immediate shipping should the Alliance ever needed them.<ref name="HS" />
